analysis.summary: Ermes Gasparini argues that Jerry Cadorette's losses to himself and Levan shouldn't lead fans to underestimate Jerry against Artyom Morozov, emphasizing Jerry's press as a viable path to victory.
analysis.popular_take: Artyom Morozov is a heavy favorite because Jerry Cadorette was easily defeated by Ermes Gasparini and Levan Saginashvili.
analysis.counter_case: Jerry Cadorette can defeat Morozov if he manages to establish his press position before Morozov can engage his hook.
